entities.surface: fine-tune the nucleotide sequence language model

evidence.evidence_text: We propose a method to fine-tune the nucleotide sequence language model and the text language model based on various databases of antibiotic resistance genes.
In this study, we use not only a nucleotide sequence-based language model but also a text language model based on PubMed articles to reflect more biological background knowledge in the model.
We also propose an LLM-based augmentation technique to supplement the data and an ensemble method to effectively combine the two models.
We also propose a benchmark for evaluating the model.
